## Review summary — change 0003 at `48f38e9`

**Tally:** 0 important, 4 nits.

**Important findings:** none.

**Nits (4):**
- `plugin/lessons/index.py:256` — `check()`'s call into `build()` always `mkdir`s `lessons/` as a side effect, even on a failed/drifted check; every other gate check is read-only on disk (doubt stated: low impact, git doesn't track empty dirs).
- `plugin/lessons/index.py:207` — `title`/`description`/heading are interpolated into `[text](file)` with no escaping; a value containing `]` or `(` would break the generated link (doubt stated: not exercised by any test or real file today).
- `plugin/gate/checks.py:1613,1635` — `from lessons import index as lessons_mod` is imported separately in two functions instead of once (doubt stated: matches the file's existing lazy-import convention elsewhere).
- `template/lessons/README.md:45` — the example frontmatter's `sources` list has no sample `run-<n>` entry even though spec.md requires one per failed run (doubt stated: doc completeness only).

**Plan conformance:** the diff touches exactly the files `plan.md`'s "Files that change" lists, in the committed order, with both manifests bumped to 0.3.6 and no guardrail file (`.claude/**`, root `CLAUDE.md`/`REVIEW.md`/`sdlc.yaml`) touched; `compileall`, `ruff check`, and the new/changed tests (`test_lessons.py`, the new `test_gate.py::*lesson*` cases, the new `test_commands_and_skills.py` cases) all pass locally, consistent with the evidence log's "1429 passed."

One note: my local `pytest` run hit `shutil.Error: Permission denied` on `tests/fixtures/sample-python-project/.env` across many unrelated tests — this is a sandbox read restriction in my review environment (also hit and documented by the implementing session itself, per `evidence/fix-response.md`'s "Verification note"), not a defect in this diff; `evidence/test.log` shows the real run going green.

Findings written to `changes/0003-lessons-with-frontmatter-and-a-generated/evidence/review-findings.json`.
